name: Mercury Edit 2
short: Inception Labs' diffusion-based next-edit prediction model for code autocomplete and multi-line edits, aligned with Kahneman-Tversky Optimization (KTO).
standout: Parallel denoising generates multi-line code diffs simultaneously for low-latency Tab completions.
tradeoff: Specialized FIM and edit endpoint tuning rather than open-ended conversational coding.
